context: A fresh main audit confirms repeated scheduled writes and automatic Pages deployments from zero-sample analytical output and telemetry-only reports. A new read-only telemetry PR passes exact-head CI and the fail-closed gate. Main remains protected according to branch metadata, but detailed protection rules are unavailable.
decisions: Scheduled analytics with zero samples must report NOT_EVALUATED and must not create a timestamp-only main commit or enter XRP prediction features.
Telemetry-only workflows must use contents:read, checkout persist-credentials:false, runner-local output and bounded Actions artifacts; no direct main commit or deployment.
PR #1391 is the tested telemetry remediation: open draft, 349 tests plus 8 subtests, fail-closed gate passed, not merged.
PR #1386 remains the tested cross-analysis and legacy accuracy remediation; it is one commit behind current main and requires fresh merge-result validation before approval.
PR #1390's scheduler allowlist does not by itself eliminate the schedule-queue main-write path; queue persistence requires a non-main durable state design or an explicit pause.
PR #1388 remains the read-only merge-queue remediation; do not dispatch the current mutation-capable manual merge queue.
Keep the approval workflow push-event/zero-job anomaly unresolved until event metadata or job-level evidence identifies the root cause; do not use manual dispatch as a diagnostic.
Keep all merges, force-pushes, main writes, deployments and paper-state mutations outside this run; green checks are not approval.
Preserve the nine-platform capability map as DESIGN ONLY until authentication and independent handoffs are tested.
Keep the legacy 45.5% accuracy metric NOT_COMPARABLE; fixed-horizon evaluation, walk-forward baselines, calibration and shadow evaluation remain unexecuted.
invariants: Main remains unchanged by this run.
All remediation PRs remain draft and unmerged.
No automatic merge, manual dispatch or deployment is performed by this run.
Zero-sample sentiment is NOT_EVALUATED, not a directional feature.
DESIGNED, EXECUTED and VERIFIED remain separate.
